ablation.name: phase4h1e_eota_spatial_fiber_a05
ablation.notes: Phase 4H.1e: EOTA + spatial_fiber + alpha=0.5. Tests if EOTA generalizes to the original 4F.1 SOTA path (spatial_fiber). If EOTA+spatial_fiber also restores alpha effectiveness (vs 4F.1 every-step alpha=1.0), this confirms EOTA is a STRUCTURAL principle applicable to any AdaIN mode, not just per_subband. Comparison: 4F.1 SOTA (spatial_fiber, every-step, alpha=1.0): clip=0.7319 lpips=0.3428. Goal: lower lpips via alpha=0.5 while keeping clip near SOTA.
